candidateRule: Original unaltered Pine breakeven event; first subsequent 1m candle must close directionally beyond the original breakeven trigger. At that confirmation close, latest completed 15m Trend Identify must match direction, and latest completed 5m EMA9 must exceed EMA21 for LONG (reverse SHORT). Enter at the following 1m open with adverse slippage. No partial higher-timeframe candles or hindsight entry at a touched historical trigger.
stopRule: Retain the signal's Pine breakeven line; fixed for the experimental trade. Target solves net reward/risk after modeled entry/exit fees and slippage. Real funding is charged separately, so realized net R can differ.
executionRule: One open position across configured symbols per independent side/account; configured symbol order breaks simultaneous-entry ties. Floor quantity to current Binance market lot step; enforce max(market lot minimum notional, minimum quantity). Reserve margin plus entry fee; compound available balance. Gap opens can overrun stops. Stop first on ambiguous same-bar stop/target. Force costed exit on the last bar of each chronological partition; never carry positions across selection boundaries.
selectionRule: For each direction, choose at most one $1000 configuration using development data only: >=100 closed trades, >=10 active UTC days, net profit>0, profit factor>=1.10; rank by net profit, then smaller drawdown. Freeze selection before validation or holdout. If none passes, freeze the least-negative development configuration for diagnosis only, never label it validated.
acceptanceRule: The frozen selection must pass separately in validation and final holdout: >=50 trades, >=5 active UTC days, positive net profit, profit factor>=1.10, positive mean normalized trade return with a 95% UTC-day block-bootstrap lower bound above zero, and positive 10bps/2tick stress result. No selecting replacement configurations based on validation/holdout. Report current-$5 exchange feasibility independently; no activation recommendation when it fails.

bootstrap.unit: UTC exit day, including zero-trade days

limitations: Retrospective frozen chronological study, not prospective live proof. Current exchange filters, not historical filters; funding actual where available; liquidation is a conservative 1% maintenance approximation using trade-price candles, not historical leverage brackets/mark-price liquidation. No order-book or queue/market-impact model. The historical window is separate from the Nov10-17 report but prior exposure to all dates cannot be independently certified.
